ajayyy 2026/11/09 21:50
I recently did a talk in opposition of this sentiment

Yes, some projects like stack overflow may be losing contributors by a large degree, but it doesn't have to be this way

I run SponsorBlock and DeArrow which are two human powered crowdsourced browser extensions that are only growing in scale in opposition to the want to slopify everything

We have 17% of submitters every week being first time contributors and 19% being old, a nice balance.

Unfortunately the talk isn't available yet but you can see the slides here https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1nGArM7c3i9cVGGvkh6ER...

>SponsorBlock

goodmythical 2026/11/10 00:31
Any are welcome, so far as I know having not checked their submission criteria, to spin it up and contribute tags to the SponsorBlock community. I'd wager there are people already doing so.

I think it would be more useful to more people to utilize the existing solution because it runs in a very small footprint for the end user. Most people wouldn't be able to run an entire TTS/LLM workflow without processing videos in the background or waiting some multiple of real-time in order to watch a video.

You could maybe do it with just LLM tagging the transcript, but that's still a ton of processing just to watch a video.

God that'd be so much wasted energy if every person wanting to skip in-video ads was running an entire LLM to do so.
